summary.intent: Determine whether the high count of 'wrong' rows from the caliper comparator was caused by the test harness or by real defects, and verify post-fix counts across five corpora (mantine, chakra, shadcn, antd, spectrum). Also name the remaining wrong rows and remove the scratch worktree.
summary.outcome: Re-ran the fixed comparator (PR #380 head) on all five corpora locally with saved inputs. Wrong rows dropped from 31 to 3, and all 3 are real caliper defects. PR #380 was judged safe to merge once CI is green.

repo: Of the original 31 'wrong' rows, 28 were harness bugs (index signatures read as properties) and 3 were real caliper defects.
The first comparator fix introduced about 19 new false wrongs, also harness-side. Antd's nine unexamined rows turned out fine and antd is now at 0.
Post-fix wrong counts: mantine 0, chakra 1, shadcn 2, antd 0, spectrum 0 (previously 0, 1, 8, 0, 22).
Real defect: shadcn `Form.watch` and `Form.getValues` have a callable type that caliper turns into an empty object. Batch 1 is fixing this.

Real gap: chakra `AbsoluteCenter.axis` has three variant literals that caliper reads, but the real type also allows responsive values. Fixing it needs the checker backend, so it stays a documented gap.

The comparator files dropped alias wrappers (487 on Mantine) under 'less precise', so `wrong` never counts them. This is a scoring gap rather than a false alarm. The resolver fix is in Batch 1, and the oracle will need a rule for it afterwards.
With the current comparator, the weekly gate should not fire falsely on spectrum or antd.
workflow: Re-running the comparator locally on saved inputs took a few seconds and needed no agent. The cost the user flagged was agent turns, not the checker.
Verify claimed fixes by re-running the comparator across every corpus, not just the one that exposed the bug. The first fix caused regressions that only showed up this way.
Separate harness false positives from real product defects before acting on a metric.

friction: The first harness fix introduced about 19 new false wrongs, which required another round of correction.
Nine antd rows could not be examined at first, leaving uncertainty until the re-run.
Agent-turn cost of diagnosing the harness was a concern the user raised.
open_items: Batch 1 needs to fix the callable-type-to-empty-object bug affecting shadcn `Form.watch` and `Form.getValues`.
Batch 1 needs to fix the resolver so alias wrappers are not dropped (487 on Mantine).
The oracle needs a rule that scores dropped alias wrappers, since the comparator currently files them under 'less precise'.
The chakra `AbsoluteCenter.axis` responsive-values gap needs the checker backend and stays documented until then.
Update the PR #380 body with the exact post-fix counts.
Merge PR #380 once its CI is green.
Remove the scratch worktree and name the remaining wrong rows, which were requested but not confirmed done in this transcript.
